facts.fact: 开场：他们没有很快释怀。
facts.anchor: They did not get over it quickly.

facts.fact: 她的作案原理：各 pack 本来就不信任彼此——只需要有人给他们许可去承认。
facts.anchor: "The packs didn't trust one another. They only needed permission to admit it."

facts.fact: 她的真实动机：我曾无力，所以我希望别人也一样。
facts.anchor: "Because I was powerless, and I wanted everyone else to feel that way too.

facts.fact: 她当面对 Gunnar 说：因为我恨你们。
她的新立场：只允许丈夫使用我。
facts.anchor: The only person I'll ever let use me is my husband.

facts.fact: Mei Ling 的判词：混乱可以逆转，Sorsha 不一样。
Mei Ling 的核心课：家人不讲逻辑，爱不是记仇的账本。
facts.anchor: Family isn't logical. Love isn't a ledger where betrayal goes in one column and affection in another

facts.fact: 信任的传递：我儿子信你，所以我信你——只有你能打破它。
facts.anchor: My son trusts you, so I trust you. Only you can break that trust.

facts.fact: Mei Ling 的权威句：我家，我的规矩。
章末喜剧：她现在要去再操她丈夫一次。
facts.anchor: I'm going to go fuck my husband again.
